The highest-ranked community desires, as indicated in focus groups, interviews, and survey results were information on home power backup options, and assistance with development of emergency power 23 plans for medical devices, temperature sensitive medicines, and overall home energy use. Residents also indicated an interest in programs to assist with cost and installation of home power backup options, however, the minimum resilience standards indicate a more cost-effective approach would be to first meet specific resilience needs based upon individual vulnerabilities. Ecolibrium3 is incorporating this education and planning assistance as part of their Energy Training Corps, which already meets with households as part of efficiency, rain-readiness, and healthy housing assessments. As an ongoing commitment to building community resilience, project partners will continue to work together to advance targeted community-based efforts. Ongoing outreach will build upon the organizations and businesses involved in the CIT and CSG to ensure broad dissemination of resources. Products The following project resources are available on the City of Duluth’s website (https://duluthmn.gov/sustain/news-updates/racer-update/). Solar Siting Rubric- The Solar Siting Rubric is best used to evaluate and rank larger (~40kW+) sites that could be suitable for solar PV and storage development. It is designed to assist owners of municipal and public infrastructure to evaluate projects and understand how solar developments can offset costs. It is recommended that the rubric be used in conjunction with community conversations to understand community factors that may impact project acceptance and implementation. Duluth MN Outage Tabletop Exercise- Tabletop exercise scenario, brief, and evaluation. Includes “persona” worksheets that were added for the community-based organization exercise to amplify vulnerable populations. Moorhead MN Tabletop Exercise- Moorhead Minnesota tabletop exercise book developed as test of the Resilience Planning Toolkit. Disaster scenario included a tornado that resulted in cascading critical infrastructure failures. SETO Session Poster- Mid-project poster for Solar Energy Technologies Office review. Duluth Minimum Resilience Standards (Appendix E)- Ten community-based minimum resilience standards that identify most vulnerable populations, negative impacts during power outages, and individual and community-based strategies for building resilience. City of Duluth Site Assessment & Evaluation for Solar PV & Storage- Solar siting workbook for Duluth sites that includes initial rubric evaluation and revised scores. Demonstrates tool application and results. Community Resilience Survey Results- Final survey questions and results used to inform selection menu for minimum resilience standards and prioritized actions. 24 Resilient Power Site Evaluations and Design (Appendix F)- Site evaluations and system designs of the top five ranked solar sites identified by the CIT using the Solar Siting Rubric and initial site investigations. Sites include a city reservoir cap, two fire halls, community center, customer service/maintenance building. Resilience Planning Toolkit- Final project deliverable designed and tested to guide capacity-limited communities in development of their own integrated resilience plan. Project Team and Roles Recipient Organization: City of Duluth For F3, the City of Duluth was the grant award recipient and co-Principle Investigator with Ecolibrium3, a community-based organization.
